description: Validate post content against each platform's rules (character limits, media counts, required fields) WITHOUT creating or scheduling anything. Supports all 12 platforms including google-business (1500 chars; postType STANDARD/EVENT/OFFER with CTA buttons via platformSettings; exactly one image, no video). Returns per-platform valid/invalid with errors and warnings.

firstComment.description: First-comment text to validate against each platform's comment limits (shorthand for firstComments: [{target: 0, text}]).

target.description: 0 = the main post (default); i = thread entry i+1 (create_thread on twitter/threads/bluesky only).

text.description: Comment text - links allowed, no media.

mediaItems.description: Media items to validate (counts, and size/dimensions if provided).

caption.description: Optional caption/alt text for this item.

type.description: Media type. 'pdf' = a LinkedIn document post (linkedin only).

platformSettings.description: Per-platform overrides keyed by platform name.

platforms.description: Platform name strings to validate against, e.g. ['twitter','bluesky'].

name: validate_post
title: Validate Post
